# Audit subject — YYYY-MM-DD

> **Frozen audit:** This document records the pin-specific inspection below. It
> does not own live state; link the canonical plan or status owner here.

## Audit record

| Field | Record |
|-------|--------|
| Date | When the inspection was performed. |
| Scope | Included and explicitly excluded material. |
| Inspected pins | Exact immutable source, package, configuration, and artifact identities. |
| Trust | `MEASURED`, `CODE-INSPECTED`, `SOURCE-CONFIRMED`, `INFERRED`, or `UNVERIFIED`. |
| Final disposition | Adopted conclusion, rejected premise, superseding owner, or no maintained action. |

## Result

State the accumulated conclusion first rather than narrating the work diary.

## Decisive evidence

Retain only the observations, counterexamples, commands, and signals needed to
reconstruct or bound the conclusion.

## Boundary and rejected interpretations

State what was not inspected or proven and why plausible alternatives were
accepted, rejected, or left unresolved.

## Public/private review

Confirm that the public record contains no private submission order,
send/withhold decision, vulnerability/CVE coordination, or working
memory-corruption reproducer. Name the private `rock-5b-security` repository
without linking it when such work exists.

## Current owner

Link the live plan, status row, project explanation, patch catalog, package
record, or runbook that now owns action and mutable state.

## Errata

Append a dated correction only for a factual error in this frozen snapshot. A
material reinterpretation belongs in a new finding while evaluated and ends in
a maintained correction or superseding audit.
